sentiment_score_definition: x <= -0.35: Bearish; -0.35 < x <= -0.15: Somewhat-Bearish; -0.15 < x < 0.15: Neutral; 0.15 <= x < 0.35: Somewhat_Bullish; x >= 0.35: Bullish
relevance_score_definition: 0 < x <= 1, with a higher score indicating higher relevance.

feed.title: Kroger tells Republican candidate to take down video filmed in store
feed.summary: Kroger has asked Republican state senate candidate Jim Croft to remove a campaign video filmed inside a Pick n' Save store. Croft had posted a 40-second video on his campaign Facebook page on August 20, where he spoke about prices and his political aspirations while pushing a shopping cart, with his campaign logo visible. The incident highlights restrictions on filming political content within private retail spaces.

feed.title: Adobe Stock Sinks After Company Names Insider as New CEO
feed.summary: Adobe's stock fell about 6% after the company named longtime executive Anil Chakravarthy as its new CEO, succeeding Shantanu Narayen who will move to an executive chair role. This leadership change occurs as Adobe faces pressure from AI-focused competitors and has seen its shares decline significantly in 2026. The market reaction suggests investors may have preferred a different approach to address the challenges posed by AI disruption.

feed.title: TBIL39 Stock Price and Chart — BMFBOVESPA:TBIL39
feed.summary: This article provides an overview of the TBIL39 (Global X 1-3 Month T-Bill ETF Shs Unsponsored Brazilian Depositary Receipt Repr 0.1 Sh) stock on the BMFBOVESPA exchange, including its current price, performance metrics over various periods, and key financial statistics. It also touches on sector information and technical indicators like oscillators and moving averages, suggesting a "Neutral" summary for both.

feed.title: Corteva’s Patent Infringement Theories Survive for Jury Trial
feed.summary: A federal judge in Delaware ruled that Corteva Agriscience LLC's patent infringement claims against Inari Agriculture Inc. will proceed to a jury trial. Inari had attempted to dismiss claims related to testing Corteva corn seeds for disease resistance, arguing Iowa State University performed the tests. However, the judge found sufficient grounds for trial given that Inari had hired a company to arrange these tests through Iowa State.

feed.title: Atn International director Prior sells $221,232 in stock By Investing.com
feed.summary: Cornelius B Prior Jr., a director and 10% owner of ATN International, Inc. (NASDAQ:ATNI), sold 7,124 shares of common stock in early September 2026 for a total of $221,232. These sales occurred in two transactions at prices ranging from $31.0177 to $31.1192 per share. Following these transactions, Prior still directly holds over 3.9 million shares, and the company recently reported strong Q2 2026 earnings, significantly exceeding expectations due to a large gain from selling part of its U.S. tower portfolio.

feed.title: Royal Caribbean cancels Alaska ‘disaster’ cruise after 1,700 guests spent days on docked ship
feed.summary: Royal Caribbean has canceled an Alaska cruise on the Serenade of the Seas after 1,700 passengers spent two days on the docked ship in Vancouver due to an unresolved technical issue. Initially, the cruise was shortened, and passengers were allowed to board early as a hotel, but ultimately, the voyage was scrapped. Guests will receive full refunds, future cruise credits, and pro-rated refunds for beverage packages.

feed.title: Moody’s changes Seplat Energy outlook on Nigeria upgrade
feed.summary: Moody's Ratings has upgraded Seplat Energy Plc's outlook from stable to positive, affirming its B2 long-term corporate family rating and B2-PD probability of default rating. This change follows Moody's similar upgrade for the Government of Nigeria, as Seplat's credit profile is closely tied to Nigeria's economic and regulatory environment. The company has shown robust operating and financial performance, with increased daily production and improved credit metrics.

feed.title: Y’all Street ramps up as BofA, Texas Capital advance Uptown projects
feed.summary: Dallas's financial sector is booming, with Bank of America progressing on its new Uptown tower and the Texas Stock Exchange and Texas Capital Bank securing approvals for their projects. These developments are contributing to the growing excitement around "Y'all Street" in Uptown, further solidifying Dallas's position as a major financial hub.

feed.title: Fair Isaac, Equifax, TransUnion Shares Fall After FHFA Director Bill Pulte's Criticism on Credit Bureaus
feed.summary: Shares of Fair Isaac, Equifax, and TransUnion declined following criticism from FHFA Director Bill Pulte regarding credit bureaus. Pulte's remarks highlighted concerns about the industry, leading to a negative market reaction for these companies. This article was published on September 4, 2026, at 03:18 pm EDT according to MT Newswires.

feed.title: Waste Management vs Republic Services: value favors WM, but momentum backs RSG
feed.summary: This article analyzes Waste Management (WM) and Republic Services (RSG), concluding that WM offers better fundamental value due to faster revenue growth, lower valuation multiples, and a larger analyst-target upside. However, RSG currently has stronger momentum, outperforming WM in shorter timeframes and exhibiting "Strong Buy" technical signals. The article advises that while WM is the better value stock, a clearer investment setup for a long WM/short RSG pair trade would require WM to stabilize and RSG's momentum to cool.

feed.title: Watch CNBC's full interview with MAI’s Chris Grisanti and Wells Fargo’s Tom Porcelli
feed.summary: This CNBC "Power Lunch" segment features an interview with Chris Grisanti of MAI and Tom Porcelli of Wells Fargo, who discuss current events impacting equity markets. The article also provides links to other recent CNBC interviews with various CEOs and market analysts.

feed.title: These companies are growing their dividends and may see upside, Morgan Stanley says
feed.summary: Morgan Stanley suggests that dividend-paying stocks can stabilize portfolios during uncertain times and has identified several companies that have consistently raised their dividends. Among those highlighted are East West Bancorp, Packaging Corporation of America, and Devon Energy, all of which show strong growth, attractive dividend yields, and positive analyst outlooks. Other companies mentioned for consistent dividend growth include Nvidia, Royal Caribbean, and Capital One Financial.

feed.title: Consumers Energy : Narrowing in on Restoration Following Powerful Storms
feed.summary: Consumers Energy crews have made significant progress in restoring power to customers after two powerful storms, with 80% of affected customers already reconnected. The company deployed hundreds of crews and a mobile command center, and expects most remaining customers to have power by Friday night, with the hardest-hit areas restored on Saturday. Consumers Energy also reminded the public about safety precautions, including staying away from downed lines and safe generator use.

feed.title: AbbVie vs. Pfizer: Which Healthcare Stock Is a Better Buy in 2026?
feed.summary: This article compares AbbVie and Pfizer as investment opportunities in 2026, highlighting their financial health, growth drivers, and risk profiles. AbbVie is expanding beyond its legacy drug Humira with new immunology and neuroscience products, while Pfizer is investing its pandemic-era profits into oncology and obesity treatments. The author suggests Pfizer might be a better value play for long-term investors due to its lower valuation metrics, despite both companies facing challenges like patent expirations and regulatory pressures.

feed.title: August Was Fastenal’s Best Sales Growth in 4 Years
feed.summary: Fastenal reported its August sales results, showing a 16.6% year-over-year increase in total sales, marking its strongest monthly sales gain in over four years and the 14th consecutive month of double-digit growth. This acceleration was observed across all geographies and major manufacturing end markets, with direct materials showing particularly strong growth. The report highlights Fastenal's continued outperformance, attributed to factors like improved customer contracts, pricing strategies, and market share gains, despite a slowdown in non-residential construction.

feed.title: Isman Adrian Acquires 10 Shares of Bunge Global SA at $119.25 Each on September 1, 2026
feed.summary: Isman Adrian, a director of Bunge Global SA, acquired 10 shares of the company on September 1, 2026, at a price of $119.25 per share. This transaction increased his total holding to 3,330 shares. The acquisition was classified under SEC code A, indicating it was an award.

feed.summary: Varadarajan Seshasayee, Senior Vice President of LAM RESEARCH CORP (NASDAQ: LRCX), sold 59,750 shares at $291.32 each on September 2, 2026. After this sale, his reported holdings decreased to 205,546 shares. Earlier, he exercised options for 39,750 shares at prices ranging from $30.03 to $59.88, bringing his total reported ownership to 233,026 shares before the sale.

feed.title: Check Your Freezer — Great Value Organic Triple Berry Blend at Walmart Is Being Recalled for E. Coli
feed.summary: Walmart is recalling its Great Value Organic Triple Berry Blend due to potential E. coli contamination. The recall affects 16 states, including Louisiana, and specifically targets 10-ounce packages with a "best if used by" date of Feb. 9, 2028, and Lot Code: 6040 01-6. Consumers are advised not to eat the berries and to return them to Walmart for a full refund, although no illnesses have been reported so far.

feed.title: Xenon to Present at Wells Fargo Healthcare Conference
feed.summary: Xenon Pharmaceuticals Inc. announced its upcoming presentation at the Wells Fargo Healthcare Conference in Boston, MA. The company will participate in a fireside chat on Wednesday, September 9, from 11:00-11:30 am ET. Xenon Pharmaceuticals is a neuroscience-focused biopharmaceutical company developing therapeutics for epilepsy, major depressive disorder, and bipolar depression.

feed.title: SPDR Series Trust - State Street SPDR S&P Metals & Mining ETF Reports Earnings Results for the Full Year Ended June 30, 2026
feed.summary: SPDR Series Trust - State Street SPDR S&P Metals & Mining ETF (XME) has reported its financial results for the full year ended June 30, 2026. The company announced revenues of USD 24.68 million and a net income of USD 997.32 million for the period.

feed.title: TD Cowen reiterates Boston Scientific stock rating on shipping restoration
feed.summary: TD Cowen has reiterated a Buy rating and a $56.00 price target for Boston Scientific following the company's announcement that it has begun restoring shipping capabilities for most products after a cybersecurity incident. Despite a 51% year-to-date decline due to the disruption, the company maintains a "GREAT" financial health score, and InvestingPro analysis suggests it is currently undervalued. Boston Scientific is working through its order backlog and expects full system remediation in one to two weeks, with other analysts like Stifel also maintaining Buy ratings, while Argus downgraded the stock to Hold.

feed.title: FICO Parent Fair Isaac and Credit Bureaus Sink. Bill Pulte Is Behind the Drop.
feed.summary: Shares of Fair Isaac, Equifax, TransUnion, and Experian dropped after social media posts from Bill Pulte, head of the Federal Housing Finance Agency. Pulte instructed Fannie Mae and Freddie Mac to approve VantageScore, a move that threatens FICO's dominance in credit scoring. This development impacts the business model of credit bureaus.

feed.title: Super Micro Surges 7% as Semiconductors Lead a Flat Tape; Hewlett Packard Enterprise Falls 3%, Dell Edges Higher
feed.summary: Super Micro Computer (SMCI) surged 7% due to strong AI server demand and a record backlog, while Hewlett Packard Enterprise (HPE) fell 3% as supply constraints hinder its ability to meet customer orders despite strong reported numbers. Dell Technologies (DELL) also saw a modest gain of 2%, benefiting from the same sector rotation toward semiconductors and AI hardware. The overall semiconductor sector, represented by the iShares Semiconductor ETF (SOXX), significantly outperformed the broader tech market (iShares U.S. Technology ETF, IYW).

feed.title: HP unveils AI-powered OmniBook laptops and OmniDesk desktop
feed.summary: HP Inc. has unveiled two new AI-powered laptops, the HP OmniBook Ultra 16 and HP OmniBook X 14, along with details for the upcoming HP OmniDesk desktop. These devices, designed for creators, developers, gamers, and AI users, feature NVIDIA RTX Spark and run on Windows. Key features include advanced memory and AI performance, high-quality OLED displays, and impressive battery life with fast-charging capabilities.

feed.title: Oracle's Next Earnings Report Could Move the Stock 11%
feed.summary: Oracle (ORCL) is set to announce its fiscal first-quarter results on September 10, with the options market predicting an 11.2% stock movement in either direction. Investors are closely watching the report to see if the company's significant investment in its AI cloud business is translating into strong growth without further substantial spending increases. Analysts anticipate $19.13 billion in revenue and earnings of $1.74 per share, with a focus on cloud growth, capital spending, and cash flow.

feed.title: Moody’s Assigns First-Time Insurance Financial Strength Ratings to Freedom Insurance and Freedom Life
feed.summary: Moody’s Ratings has assigned first-time insurance financial strength ratings to Freedom Finance Insurance JSC (Freedom Insurance) and Freedom Life JSC, both subsidiaries of Freedom Holding Corp. Freedom Insurance received Ba1 ratings, while Freedom Life received Baa3 ratings, marking it as the first investment-grade rating within Freedom Holding Corp. These ratings acknowledge the insurers' strong market positions in Kazakhstan, conservative investment strategies, and integration into the broader Freedom Holding Corp. ecosystem.

feed.title: Traders Buy High Volume of Call Options on Devon Energy (NYSE:DVN)
feed.summary: Traders have shown increased bullish interest in Devon Energy (NYSE:DVN) with a surge in call option activity, exceeding typical daily volumes by 21%. Analysts generally maintain a "Moderate Buy" rating with an average price target of $59.23, supported by the company's strong quarterly financial results, which surpassed earnings and revenue expectations, and a declared quarterly dividend. Despite mixed price target adjustments from various brokerages, Devon Energy's positive performance and analyst outlook seem to be driving investor confidence.

feed.title: Eaton to Boost U.S. Power Capacity With $242M Arkansas Plant
feed.summary: Eaton Corporation plans to invest over $242 million in a new one-million-square-foot manufacturing facility in North Little Rock, Arkansas, to double the U.S. production capacity of its Fibrebond business. This expansion aims to address growing demand for critical-power infrastructure, create 1,200 jobs, and strengthen Eaton's position in AI infrastructure, grid modernization, and electrification. The move follows strong financial performance and similar expansion efforts by competitors like Rockwell Automation and Vertiv.

feed.title: Why Is NiSource (NI) Down 4% Since Last Earnings Report?
feed.summary: NiSource (NI) shares have dropped 4% since its last earnings report, despite the company beating Q2 2026 adjusted earnings estimates with 16 cents per share. The company reported increased revenues driven by NIPSCO gains and is advancing its data center strategy, projecting significant savings and capacity growth. NiSource reaffirmed its 2026 earnings guidance and long-term capital investment plan.

feed.title: HP Announces New OmniBook PCs to Help Build the Next Generation of AI Experiences
feed.summary: HP Inc. announced new OmniBook Ultra 16 and OmniBook X 14 PCs, along with details for the upcoming OmniDesk, all powered by NVIDIA RTX Spark and Windows. These devices are designed for creators, developers, and advanced AI users, focusing on delivering personal agents, local AI, and advanced content creation capabilities in highly portable and powerful form factors. The new lineup aims to redefine how users interact with AI in their daily workflows, supporting complex projects and emerging AI applications.

feed.title: JPMorgan hires healthcare banker David Blais from Guggenheim, sources say
feed.summary: JPMorgan Chase & Co. has hired David Blais, a senior healthcare investment banker specializing in M&A, from Guggenheim Securities. Blais will join JPMorgan later this month as a managing director, reporting to co-heads of healthcare investment banking Jerry Lee and Nick Richitt. He previously worked at Citigroup and JPMorgan, and has been with Guggenheim since 2014.

feed.title: O'Reilly's heads to City of Tonawanda
feed.summary: O'Reilly Auto Parts is set to open a new location in the City of Tonawanda, taking over a former Rite Aid pharmacy building at 47 Niagara Street. The company paid $1.65 million for the 12,738-square-foot property, which had been vacant for two years. This acquisition is part of a larger trend of O'Reilly Auto Parts purchasing former Rite Aid sites for expansion.

feed.title: DOJ expands beef price investigation to Kroger, Walmart, Costco and other major retailers
feed.summary: The U.S. Department of Justice has broadened its investigation into rising beef prices, requesting information from eight major grocery retailers, including Kroger, Walmart, and Costco. This expansion seeks to determine if high beef prices are due to supply-and-demand or potentially anticompetitive practices in the retail sector, building on an existing antitrust probe into the meatpacking industry. The inquiry does not imply wrongdoing by the retailers.

feed.title: Valley Water Selects AECOM For Pure Water Facility Design
feed.summary: The Santa Clara Valley Water District has chosen AECOM to design the Pure Water Silicon Valley Demonstration Facility Project. This initiative aims to evaluate direct potable reuse as a potential future drinking water source for the region. The project will include a new pilot facility capable of producing 200 gallons of water per minute and a LEED-certified learning center for education and community engagement.

feed.title: American Financial Group Lifted Its Dividend 10.2% and Kept Buying Back Stock
feed.summary: American Financial Group (AFG) increased its annual dividend by 10.2% and has an impressive 21-year streak of dividend increases, along with a near 2.5% dividend yield. The property and casualty insurer reported a strong combined ratio of 91.6% in Q2 2026, improving from the previous year, and continued its stock buyback program, purchasing $86 million in shares year-to-date. Despite increasing competition in the insurance industry, the company's stock appears reasonably priced, making it an attractive option for dividend growth investors.

feed.title: Southern Co CEO Peter Sena sells $377,924 in stock By Investing.com
feed.summary: Peter P. Sena III, CEO of Southern Company, sold 4,266 shares of company stock for a total of $377,924. This sale occurred while the stock was near its 52-week low, and InvestingPro data indicates the company is currently overvalued. Despite this, Southern Company recently surpassed earnings expectations for Q2 2026 and adjusted its full-year outlook higher due to strong growth factors.

feed.title: Final Trades: FTAI Aviation, KLA Corp, Nvidia and Oracle
feed.summary: The Investment Committee has provided their top stock picks for the second half, featuring FTAI Aviation, KLA Corp, Nvidia, and Oracle. The article presents a video discussing these "Final Trades" along with other market-related content, including insights on preemptive rate hikes and the "Magnificent Seven" investment strategy. It also includes videos on political and economic news, such as Trump's stance on Fed rates and reactions to the August jobs report.

feed.title: Associated Banc (NYSE:ASB) EVP Patrick Edward Ahern Sells 1,309 Shares
feed.summary: Associated Banc EVP Patrick Ahern sold 1,309 shares of ASB stock for $40,382.65, reducing his direct ownership by 2.91%. The company reported strong quarterly earnings of $0.73 EPS, exceeding consensus, and announced a $0.24 quarterly dividend. Analysts maintain a "Moderate Buy" rating with a $32.00 average price target for ASB.

feed.title: Zegna’s (ZGN) Direct Sales Surge Can’t Fully Offset A Messier Profit
feed.summary: Ermenegildo Zegna Group reported a 6.4% year-over-year revenue increase in the first half of 2026, driven significantly by a 15.8% organic surge in direct-to-consumer sales, which now account for 86% of branded revenue. Despite this strong top-line performance and improved operating profit, net profit declined due to non-recurring gains from the previous year, higher tax rates, and negative swings in financial and foreign exchange effects. The Thom Browne segment also experienced a revenue decline and shifted to a loss, while overall hedge fund ownership increased, suggesting the market views the profit dip as temporary noise rather than a long-term trend.

feed.title: Gartner: Hypervisor Replatforming Is Reshaping Storage and Virtualization Decisions
feed.summary: Gartner's latest Magic Quadrant for Enterprise Storage Platforms indicates that hypervisor replatforming is fundamentally changing how organizations evaluate virtualization and storage. This shift is driven by widespread licensing and pricing changes, prompting IT leaders to consider virtualization and storage as a combined entity, prioritizing multihypervisor flexibility and container interoperability. Furthermore, the report highlights a move towards consumption-based storage-as-a-service (STaaS) models to combat rising hardware costs and predicts that STaaS will replace 50% of on-premises storage capex by 2029.

feed.title: Pathlock Recognized as a Representative Vendor in the 2026 Gartner® Market Guide for Identity Governance and Administration
feed.summary: Pathlock has been recognized as a Representative Vendor in the 2026 Gartner Market Guide for Identity Governance and Administration. The report highlights the evolution of IGA towards autonomous and continuous processes, emphasizing the need for AI-enabled platforms to manage identity risks and streamline compliance. Pathlock's AI-native platform unifies identity governance and real-time transaction-level analytics, addressing the challenges of governing both human and non-human identities in critical business applications.

feed.title: Future of MarineMax’s 70-dealership network a question mark in Blackstone sale
feed.summary: The future of MarineMax's extensive 70-dealership network, brokerage, and manufacturing operations remains uncertain following its sale to Blackstone's Safe Harbor Marinas. While MarineMax CEO is set for a significant payout, the transition raises questions about how Safe Harbor will integrate these aspects into its marina-focused strategy. The Tampa Bay area will also lose a publicly traded headquarters with this acquisition.

feed.title: Hormel (HRL) Expanded Adjusted Operating Margin Despite a Volume Decline. Can Cost Savings Carry the Turnaround?
feed.summary: Hormel Foods Corporation (HRL) reported a 2.4% sales decrease and a 7.4% volume decline in Q3, yet expanded its adjusted operating margin to 9.0% due to significant cost savings, particularly in selling, general, and administrative expenses. While the foodservice segment showed growth, broad declines in retail and international volumes raise questions about the sustainability of the turnaround based solely on cost reductions rather than demand stabilization. The company's adjusted results exclude substantial pre-tax items, making the true profitability picture complex.

feed.title: Bill Gates Held This 'Garbage' Stock Since 2008 — And He's Still Buying
feed.summary: Bill Gates' private investment vehicle, Cascade Investment, has significantly increased its stake in Republic Services, Inc. (NYSE: RSG), purchasing over $424.8 million worth of shares in recent days. This extends a long-term investment Gates has held in the waste management company since 2008, highlighting his confidence in its "boring but reliable" business model. The aggressive buying signals strong conviction in Republic Services as a defensive, cash-generative asset.

feed.title: AFLAC Inc. stock holds firm as Japan Post trims stake and Q2 2026 results miss EPS consensus
feed.summary: AFLAC Inc. stock is trading near USD 118, holding firm despite Japan Post Holdings reducing its stake and the company missing Q2 2026 EPS consensus. While revenue slightly beat forecasts, the earnings shortfall and insider selling provide a mixed picture for investors. Analysts maintain a "Hold" rating with an average price target below current trading levels, suggesting limited upside despite strong long-term performance and a consistent dividend yield.

feed.title: McKesson Data Breach Lawsuit Investigation
feed.summary: Shamis & Gentile P.A. is investigating a data breach at McKesson Corporation that occurred on August 28, 2026, where a threat actor named ShinyHunters claimed responsibility for unauthorized access to third-party applications and data acquisition. The breach affected customer data within McKesson's Oncology & Specialty and Medical-Surgical business units. Individuals impacted by the breach may be entitled to compensation through a class action lawsuit.

feed.title: Motorola Solutions (NYSE:MSI): Is Its Valuation Ahead of Cash Flow?
feed.summary: Motorola Solutions (NYSE:MSI) faces a valuation debate following its acquisition of D-Fend Solutions, which expands its counter-drone technology offerings within public safety. While the company's strategic positioning and strong cash generation are positive, valuation analyses using DCF and earnings multiples suggest that the current market price reflects substantial future growth expectations that may be ahead of conservative projections. The success of the D-Fend integration and sustained cash-flow expansion will be crucial in justifying its premium valuation.

It details key financial statistics, recent price performance, company information, and technical analysis indicators. feed.title: Was JNJ Stock Rally Actually Its Own?
feed.summary: Johnson & Johnson (JNJ) stock saw a significant 59.9% rally over the past year, far outpacing the S&P 500. While the company absorbed a biosimilar hit to STELARA sales and proposed a large talc litigation settlement, these factors don't fully explain the stock's substantial growth, nor are all issues fully resolved. The article suggests that while JNJ's operational growth is real, its performance is also part of a broader sector upturn and highlights the ongoing nature of the talc agreement.
